tasks.CalculateBottlesOfBleachCost: Compute the cost for bottles of bleach based on the total number of clients.
tasks.CalculatePacksOfClothsCost: Compute the cost for packs of cloths based on the total number of clients.
tasks.CalculateProfit: Determine Kim's profit by subtracting total expenses from his total income.
tasks.CalculateTotalClients: Determine the total number of clients Kim will have after including potential clients.
tasks.CalculateTotalExpenses: Sum up the expenses (bottles of bleach and packs of cloths) to get the total weekly expense.
